## REAL-TIME FOCAL PLANE ESTIMATION

Planets are mutually incoherent with their

host star

By modulating the deformable mirrors

while observing a target, we can acquire an estimate of the coherent electric field in the science image as it is varying in time

The coherent intensity can then be

removed from the science image to extract the planet signal
